sessionStart.command: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ -n "${BD_BIN:-}" ]; then export PATH="${BD_BIN%/*}:$PATH"; fi; "${GC_BIN:-gc}" prime --hook

preCompact.command: export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/go/bin:$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ -n "${BD_BIN:-}" ]; then export PATH="${BD_BIN%/*}:$PATH"; fi; "${GC_BIN:-gc}" handoff --auto "context cycle"
